title: Neon Courier — One-Button Rooftop Heist

checks.name: headless simulation suite (52 assertions)
checks.details: Extracts the inline script from index.html, boots it against a DOM/Canvas stub and drives the real fixed-timestep simulation and the real renderer. Covers attract survival and variety, a bot-played 120s run with restarts, coyote time, jump buffering, charged jump, dash, sign breaking, seed determinism, localStorage persistence, entity/particle bounds, resize safety, reduced-motion playability and exception-free rendering in every mode. 52 passed, 0 failed.

checks.name: real-browser input, resize and console hygiene (18 assertions)
checks.details: Drives index.html from file:// in local Chrome over the DevTools Protocol with genuine key and pointer events. Confirms attract animates for 7s before any input, Space transitions into a fresh run, pointer tap jumps, an airborne tap dashes (vxBoost 1180), a 360ms hold charges the jump to vy -1158 vs -940 for a tap, P freezes and resumes the simulation, M toggles sound both ways, R restarts instantly, two device-metrics resizes leave world coordinates untouched, 4 focusable buttons plus a focusable labelled canvas exist, the live region carries state, and ~25s of play produces zero console errors, warnings or uncaught exceptions. 18 passed, 0 failed.

checks.name: attract-mode screenshot at 7 seconds
checks.details: Captured the 1600x900 attract frame at the 7-second mark and inspected it. Shows the title treatment, the running courier mid-stride, rooftops with gaps and corner markers, a crate, three parallax skyline layers, rain, neon signs and the full HUD (score, best, distance, speed, daily seed, objective, heat ribbon). The demo courier had travelled 208m under its own control.

checks.name: no remote runtime reference
checks.details: No matches. index.html has exactly one inline script block, no external script/link/img/font/audio references and no network APIs in the runtime. check.mjs asserts the same thing statically.

checks.name: collision integrity under bot play
checks.details: Instrumented every physics tick of a bot-played run for the deepest overlap of the player box into any rooftop body: max penetration 0.0 px. Two real bugs found and fixed during development this way - small upward roof steps let a grounded courier fall inside a building, and an airborne courier clipping a roof corner slipped through the wall face entirely.

checks.name: visual inspection of gameplay, game-over and reduced-motion states
checks.details: Rendered and inspected screenshots of live gameplay (courier mid-jump over a gap with parallax and ground shadow), the game-over overlay (RUN TERMINATED, crash reason, score/distance/near-miss summary, best score, restart prompt) and reduced-motion play (thinner rain, no flashes, still fully playable). Also rendered a zoomed pose sheet confirming the run, jump, dash, stumble and crash poses are visually distinct.

summary: A single-file Canvas 2D one-button endless runner that opens directly from disk. The courier auto-runs across procedurally assembled rooftops built from eight curated segment templates seeded by a daily-style seed shown in the HUD, dodging gaps, crates, overhead gantries, drones, sweepers and breakable neon signs. One button covers everything: tap to jump, hold to charge a higher jump, tap airborne to dash through signs, tap after a crash to restart, with coyote time and jump buffering for fairness. Near misses feed a decaying combo multiplier, and close calls trigger slow motion with a flash and shake. Difficulty and speed ramp smoothly with distance. An attract-mode bot plays a real run through the same one-button interface before the first input, so the page is animated and representative on load. The visual layer is a rain-soaked neon graphic-novel city with three parallax skyline layers, lit windows, antennae, neon signs, mist, lightning, speed lines, controlled screen shake and a rim-lit courier with distinct run, jump, dash, stumble and crash poses. Simulation runs on a fixed 1/120s timestep with sub-stepped collision resolution that prevents tunnelling, streamed and recycled level segments, pooled particles, and a virtual 1600x900 coordinate space so resizing cannot corrupt collision geometry. Reduced motion, keyboard focus, an accessible label and a live status region are all supported; generated Web Audio is opt-in only.
